pilot.primary_comparison: Same initial weights, optimizer parameters, loss weights, 3000 updates, point/rank counts and frozen evaluation queries. Two seeds on GPU0/1. Final checkpoints only. No budget extensions.
pilot.structure_criteria: Improvement must include unseen-layout completion and complete teacher-path strict descent or branch correctness, with lower unit-drop residual, no material near-goal regression, and the same direction in both seeds. Report layout-bootstrap intervals. No scaling from training loss, a single seed, or a noisy point estimate alone.
pilot.information_difference: A original accepted branch bank; B all allowed finite states for identical targets; C adds eight ordinary intermediate target basins per training layout; D additionally labels permitted policy-visited states and upweights whole failed target graphs across all layers by two. No isolated hard-edge replay.
pilot.final_test: None in this development pilot. Previously used validation layouts are not an independent final generalization test.

scope: Same independent Q MLP and directed_max distance; original Huber plus complete-candidate soft rank; exact complete terminal goal at inference. No new loss, architecture, search, filtering, inference subgoals or extra inference budget.
